Specified actual read length as min(requested, logical length), returned bytes as the logical FIFO prefix, remaining logical content as the suffix, and the read index as a modular advance.
Kept case_lib mathematical: it contains extensional slice/read predicates and no C control-flow mirror, generated-artifact import, Admitted, or extra Axiom.
No executable C statement was changed; annotation-stripped per-function executable body hashes match the incoming bodies.
